profile.headline: Lead Product & Growth Engineer | Staff Software Engineer – Payments at BILL
profile.summary:
A Software Engineer with passion to build new things, find and solve problems. I enjoy programming with no language constraints. I enjoy to learn new technologies.

Specialties: 


--Programming Languages   : Java, JavaScript, Perl, SilkTest, Shell,Expect

--Database Systems         : Oracle 8i, Mysql

--Development Tools         : eclipse, JCreator, JBuilder, NetBeans, xcode

--Web Technology             : PHP, JSP, Servlets, HTML, CSS, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, JavaScript, BootStrap, CGI ,Spring MVC, Tapestry 4, Angularjs 

--Protocol Analyzer Tools   : Wireshark, Fiddler, Tcpdump

positions.title: Lead Product & Growth Engineer | Staff Software Engineer – Payments
positions.description:
Serving as a lead product and growth engineer for BILL’s Pay By Card platform, helping scale the product from approximately $10K to more than $150M in monthly payment volume.

I operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and strategic partnerships—identifying growth opportunities, shaping product requirements, designing payment architecture, and leading delivery across internal teams and external financial partners.

( in the absence of resources ) I played a pivotal technical and product leadership role in a 1.5-year J.P. Morgan integration, partnering with JPMC and coordinating across engineering, product, risk, billing, reporting, SRE, and payment-platform teams. The program included card enrollment, dynamic processor routing, payments, refunds, disputes, risk integration, reconciliation, reporting, operational readiness, and production rollout.

Beyond implementation, I have frequently performed product-management responsibilities by clarifying ambiguous requirements, managing cross-team dependencies, prioritizing technical and customer needs, resolving partner integration challenges, and driving long-running initiatives from concept through production.

( now about AI ) 

I also design AI-powered workflows and agentic automation. My work includes an invoice-extraction platform that combines OCR, LLM-based information extraction, workflow orchestration, validation, and structured JSON generation—transforming unstructured financial documents into reliable, automation-ready data.

I have also explored AI agents for engineering operations, incident investigation, runbook intelligence, and workflow automation. My focus is not simply on calling an LLM, but on building governed, observable, and production-ready AI systems that can learn from organizational knowledge and integrate safely with existing platforms

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Built microservice using AWS API gateway, AWS lambda to cache API calls. Also utilized AWS cloudwatch, AWS IAM services
●	Designed and built components that can be used throughout the Web Application with 90% test coverage using Jasmine unit testing framework and Protractor E2E testing
●	helped new engineers to become part of the team

●	Upgraded SPA from angular version 1.2 to 1.5
●	Driven the effort to implement the college planner / Goal based framework
●	Always proponent of improving UX, designs and product behaviors
●	Implemented backend logging system to understand user behavior, drop off points and system failures
●	Built UI components using AngularJS, Bower, Gulp, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Product Designer, Engineer
positions.description:
• Built easy use product for small business owners to tackle employee hiring process 

• Designed and implemented different components of the system using Spring, REST APIs, Grails, Angular, Bootstrap

positions.title: software engineer - frontend
positions.description:
• Worked on a gas management product that is used by PG&E, Chevron etc.
• Building new features using JAVA, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, J-Query, Spring Framework, JSTL and Handlebars-JS
• Integrated Jq-Grid in place of spring “display–table” tags and enabled ajax based dynamic loading of data
• Worked with product manager, business analyst, backend engineers to build functionality with constant iteration 
• Build dynamic tables using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, J-Query, Jq-Grid, REST and Spring MVC
• Training associate engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Experience of working on web application having 7 million registered users with high availability and high traffic 
•	We had 2 million spin data for slot/bingo/table games in one day
•	Experience of working with very small team of 16 people with only 4 engineers.
•	Experience of doing full stack web-Application development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, Tapestry Framework, JAVA, JPA/Hibernate, Spring MVC, Mongo DB, Redis, JSP
•	Worked on Facebook API integration
•	Helped company to build new features individually and with team
•	Built the REST API using Spring MVC, JAVA, JPA/Hibernate for User’s new levels 
•	Built the “Virtual currency purchase” functionality from end –to –end
•	Wrote unit tests using Mockito, HttpUnitTest and Selenium
•	Experience of integrating partner company ’s flash based games to provide users great experience
•	Hands on experience with Ruby with Rails
•	Experience of working on production environment with 25 servers including 3 Application servers, 3 API servers, 1 database server and other Poker servers Worked on finding and solving production problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• ­­ Code refactoring and solving problems in  SAAS based Advanced Metering Management (Smart Grid) product 
• ­­ Experience of working on Web-Services
• ­­ Implemented support for all the Timezones using JAVA , web-services and spring
• ­­ Created a base for Integration-test framework for applications of the organization
• ­­ Experience of working on the UI Automation Framework project
• ­­ Experience of working in a agile development (Scrum)
• ­­ Developed database scripts to do time shifting for all data in DB Schemas for Oracle

positions.title: R & D Engineer
positions.description:
• Working on JAVA Swing, JGraph (Open Source JAVA APIS) and XML to build GUI automation tool 
• Users (Internal QA) can drag & drop network devices to create topology graph
• Configuration files for testing framework created dynamically based on graph

positions.title: Network QA - Intern
positions.description:
• Write the Perl script, Shell script and Expect for automation tools
• Developed a web application for internal use with HTML, CSS, CGI and perl
• Worked on the Selenium for GUI automation using JAVA, Perl, XML and TestNG
• Responsible for doing sanity testing for DNS, DHCP, RADIUS and SNMP protocols
• Wrote the 4Test script for the Bug Automation using silk test

positions.title: Software Development
positions.description:
